title: make bundle is not a real target -- CLAUDE.md documents a nonexistent command
body: The Commands block lists 'make bundle # build the distributable bundle' and line 12 tells readers to run it before every release. This repo's Makefile has no 'bundle' target at all (it has 'build', which runs 'uv build' to produce the package distribution). A reader who trusts this doc and runs 'make bundle' before a release gets a 'No rule to make target' error and either blocks their release or wrongly concludes the build step does not exist. Fix: add the missing 'bundle' target, or correct the doc to reference the existing 'make build' target.
